note: Missouri River boat-ramp access where the Middle River channel joins, reached by a gravel lane through riverside woods. MDC's designated camping spot is at the north edge of the gravel ramp lot, against the woods; no amenities. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: map-designated primitive camping at the edge of the ramp lot (GIS 382, under canopy 47 m NE of lot 229). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Pin move onto the lot suggested; phone matches; not waterfront kept.
flags: INCLUSION OK (designated point at a ramp lot): area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; Rule 140 'Camping is allowed in designated area only.'; the area map (© 5/08) puts its one 'Primitive Camping Area' symbol right beside the Parking Lot at the boat ramp; GIS 27 point 382 'Primitive Camping Area'. A designated point at the lot edge keeps it (Lick Creek precedent), though in practice a rig camps in the ramp lot. No special-use-only rule, no Rule 101.

PIN: stored 38.65305,-91.88528 = GIS 382, under the riverside tree canopy 47 m NE of lot 229 (38.65266,-91.88550). Suggest 38.65300,-91.88542, the north end of the gravel lot ~13 m from the GIS point. The lot is a large open gravel area (~110 x 35 m) at the end of a gravel lane from County Road 479; a 23-ft rig reaches it. No ford or posted limit.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The camping point and the north end of the lot are ~40-60 m from the Missouri River bank through a band of trees; only the ramp lane at the lot's south end is open to the water.
HORSES: none. CLUSTERS: one camping point.
